capabilities: Open the current note in the Mobi editor via command, sidebar button, or file menu
Typeset the note online in a tab or offline via a local loopback server
Copy the formatted result for pasting into WeChat Official Accounts
Optionally write edits back to the note (two-way sync)
Download and SHA-256-verify the offline bundle on first use
disambiguation: Not an editor for .mobi ebook files; 'Mobi' is the name of a WeChat typesetting web app (mobieditor.cn) embedded in a tab.
extras: README carries a detailed network/privacy section: online mode loads mobieditor.cn in an iframe and passes note text via postMessage; offline mode serves an ~8 MB bundle (mobi-offline.bin) from a 127.0.0.1-only server, downloaded once from the plugin's GitHub release and verified by size and SHA-256. Anonymous usage stats are off by default. The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to typeset a note for WeChat Official Accounts, whose editor requires formatted rich text rather than raw Markdown.

relations.evidence: Open Mobi inside Obsidian desktop, format a note, and copy it into WeChat Official Accounts.

requires.name: AI provider and image host credentials

summary: Bridge that opens the Mobi web editor inside Obsidian desktop to typeset a Markdown note and copy it into WeChat Official Accounts.
